<A name="page_1"></A><BR>

<a name="_bclPageBorder1"></a><DIV STYLE="PADDING-RIGHT: 0%; PADDING-LEFT: 0%">
<P style="text-align: center;">
<B><FONT size=3 face="Arial">THE VANGUARD FUNDS&#146;</FONT></B><BR>
<B><FONT size=3 face="Arial">CODE OF ETHICS</FONT></B><BR>
<B><FONT size=3 face="Arial">FOR</FONT></B><BR>
<B><FONT size=3 face="Arial">SENIOR EXECUTIVE AND FINANCIAL OFFICERS</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=3 face="Arial">I. Introduction</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=3 face="Arial">The Board of Trustees of each registered investment company that is managed, sponsored, and distributed by The Vanguard Group, Inc. (&#147;VGI&#148;) (each a &#147;Vanguard Fund&#148; and collectively the &#147;Vanguard Funds&#148;) has adopted this code of ethics (the &#147;Code&#148;) as required by Section 406 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act. The Code applies to the individuals in positions listed on Exhibit A (the &#147;Covered Officers&#148;). All Covered Officers, along with employees of The Vanguard Group, Inc., are subject to separate and distinct obligations from this Code under a Code of Ethics adopted pursuant to Rule 17j-1 under the Investment Company Act of 1940 (&#147;17j-1 Code of Ethics&#148;), policies to prevent the misuse of non-public information, and other internal compliance guidelines and policies that may be in effect from time to time.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">This Code is designed to promote:</FONT></P>
<UL>
<LI>
<P align="justify"><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Honest and ethical conduct, including the ethical handling of conflicts of interest;</FONT></P></LI>
<LI>
<P align="justify"><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Full, fair, accurate, timely, and understandable disclosure in reports and documents that</FONT> <FONT size=3 face="Arial">a Vanguard Fund files with, or submits to, the U.S. Securities and Exchange</FONT> <FONT size=3 face="Arial">Commission (&#147;SEC&#148;), and in other public communications made by the Vanguard</FONT> <FONT size=3 face="Arial">Funds or VGI;</FONT></P></LI>
<LI>
<P align="justify"><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Compliance with applicable laws, governmental rules, and regulations;</FONT></P></LI>
<LI>
<P align="justify"><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Prompt internal reporting to those identified in the Code of violations of the Code; and</FONT></P></LI>
<LI>
<P align="justify"><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Accountability for adherence to the Code.</FONT></P></LI>
</UL>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=3 face="Arial">II. Actual or Apparent Conflicts of Interest</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">A. Covered Officers should conduct all activities in accordance with the following principles:</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">1. </FONT><U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Clients&#146; interests come first</FONT></U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">. In the course of fulfilling their duties and responsibilities to Vanguard clients, Covered Officers must at all times place the interests of Vanguard clients first. In particular, Covered Officers must avoid serving their own personal interests ahead of the interests of Vanguard clients.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">2. </FONT><U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Conflicts of interest must be avoided</FONT></U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">. Covered Officers must avoid any situation involving an actual or potential conflict of interest or possible impropriety with respect to their duties and responsibilities to Vanguard clients. Covered Officers must disclose any situation that may present the potential for a conflict of interest to Vanguard&#146;s Compliance Department, consistent with the 17j-1 Code of Ethics.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">III.14b.1</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT color="#bfbfbf" size=2 face="Arial">July 21, 2016</FONT></P>
</DIV>

<DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always">&nbsp;</div>



<!--$$/page=-->
<A name="page_2"></A><BR>

<a name="_bclPageBorder2"></a><DIV STYLE="PADDING-RIGHT: 0%; PADDING-LEFT: 0%">
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">3. </FONT><U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Compromising situations must be avoided</FONT></U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">. Covered Officers must not take advantage of their position of trust and responsibility. Covered Officers must avoid any situation that might compromise or call into question their exercise of full independent judgment in the best interests of Vanguard clients.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">All activities of Covered Officers should be guided by and adhere to these fiduciary standards regardless of whether the activity is specifically described in this Code.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">B. Restricted Activities</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">1. </FONT><U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Prohibition on secondary employment</FONT></U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">. Covered Officers are prohibited from accepting or serving in any form of secondary employment. Secondary employment that does not create a potential conflict of interest may be approved by the General Counsel of VGI.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">2. </FONT><U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Prohibition on service as director or public official</FONT></U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">. Unless approved by the General Counsel of VGI, Covered Officers are prohibited from serving on the board of directors of any publicly traded company or in an official capacity for any federal, state, or local government (or governmental agency or instrumentality).</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">3. </FONT><U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Prohibition on misuse of Vanguard time or property</FONT></U><FONT size=3 face="Arial">. Covered Officers are prohibited from making use of time, equipment, services, personnel or property of any Vanguard entity for any purposes other than the performance of their duties and responsibilities in connection with the Vanguard Funds or other Vanguard-related entities.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=3 face="Arial">III. Disclosure and Compliance</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">A. Each Covered Officer should be familiar with the disclosure requirements generally applicable to the Vanguard Funds.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">B. Each Covered Officer should not knowingly misrepresent, or cause others to misrepresent, facts about the Vanguard Funds to others, including to the Vanguard Funds&#146; directors and auditors, or to government regulators and self-regulatory organizations.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">C. Each Covered Officer should, to the extent appropriate within the Covered Officer&#146;s area of responsibility, consult with other officers and employees of VGI and advisers to a Vanguard Fund with the goal of promoting full, fair, accurate, timely and understandable disclosure in the reports and documents the fund files with, or submits to, the SEC and in other public communications made by a Vanguard Fund.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">D. It is the responsibility of each Covered Officer to promote compliance with the standards and restrictions imposed by applicable laws, rules, regulations, and the 17j-1 Code of Ethics.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">III.14b.2</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT color="#bfbfbf" size=2 face="Arial">July 21, 2016</FONT></P>
</DIV>

<DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always">&nbsp;</div>



<!--$$/page=-->
<A name="page_3"></A><BR>

<a name="_bclPageBorder3"></a><DIV STYLE="PADDING-RIGHT: 0%; PADDING-LEFT: 0%">
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=3 face="Arial">IV. Reporting and Accountability</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">A. Each Covered Officer must:</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">1. </FONT><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Upon adoption or amendment of the Code (or thereafter as applicable, upon becoming a Covered Officer), affirm in writing that he or she has received, read, and understands the Code;</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">2. </FONT><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Affirm at least annually in writing that he or she has complied with the requirements of the Code;</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">3. </FONT><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Not retaliate against any other Covered Officer or any employee of VGI for reports of potential violations of the Code that are made in good faith; and</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">4. </FONT><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Notify the General Counsel of VGI promptly if the Covered Officer knows of any violations of this Code.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">B. The Vanguard Funds will use the following procedures in investigating and enforcing this Code:</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">1. </FONT><FONT size=3 face="Arial">The General Counsel of VGI is responsible for applying this Code to specific situations and has the authority to interpret this Code in any particular situation. The General Counsel will report on an as-needed basis to the Board of Trustees regarding activities subject to the Code.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">2. </FONT><FONT size=3 face="Arial">The General Counsel will take all appropriate action to investigate any potential violations of the Code that are reported to him or her.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">3. </FONT><FONT size=3 face="Arial">If, after investigation, the General Counsel believes that no material violation of the Code has occurred, the General Counsel is not required to take any further action.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">4. </FONT><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Any matter that the General Counsel believes is a material violation of the Code will be reported to the Chief Compliance Officer and the Board of Trustees of the Vanguard Funds.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">5. </FONT><FONT size=3 face="Arial">If the Board of Trustees of the Vanguard Funds concurs that a material violation of the Code has occurred, the Board will consider appropriate action. Appropriate action may include reassignment, suspension, or dismissal of the applicable Covered Officer(s), or any other sanctions the Board deems appropriate. Appropriate action may also include review of, and appropriate modifications to, applicable policies and procedures.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">6. </FONT><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Any changes to or waiver of this Code will, to the extent required, be disclosed as provided by SEC rules.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">III.14b.3</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT color="#bfbfbf" size=2 face="Arial">July 21, 2016</FONT></P>
</DIV>

<DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always">&nbsp;</div>

<A name="page_4"></A><BR>

<a name="_bclPageBorder4"></a><DIV STYLE="PADDING-RIGHT: 0%; PADDING-LEFT: 0%">
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=3 face="Arial">Other Policies and Procedures</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=3 face="Arial">This Code shall be the sole code of conduct adopted by the Vanguard Funds for purposes of Section 406 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and the rules and forms applicable to registered investment companies thereunder. Insofar as other policies or procedures of the Vanguard Funds, VGI, or other service providers govern or purport to govern the behavior or activities of the Covered Officers, they are superseded by this Code to the extent that they overlap or conflict with the provisions of this Code.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=3 face="Arial">VGI&#146;s and the Vanguard Funds&#146; 17j-1 Code of Ethics, policies to prevent the misuse of non-public information, and other internal compliance guidelines and policies that may be in effect from time to time are separate requirements applying to the Covered Officers and others, and are not part of this Code.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=3 face="Arial">VI. Amendments</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=3 face="Arial">This Code may not be materially amended except by the approval of a majority vote of the independent trustees of the Vanguard Funds&#146; Board of Trustees. Non-material, technical, and administrative revisions of the Code do not have to be approved by the Board of Trustees. Amendments must be in writing and communicated promptly to the Covered Officers, who shall affirm receipt of the amended Code in accordance with Section IV. A. 1.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<B><FONT size=3 face="Arial">VII. Confidentiality</FONT></B></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=3 face="Arial">All reports and records prepared or maintained pursuant to this Code shall be considered confidential and shall be maintained and protected accordingly. Except as otherwise required by law or this Code, such matters shall not be disclosed to anyone other than the Vanguard Funds&#146; Board of Trustees, VGI&#146;s General Counsel and the Chief Compliance Officer of VGI and the Vanguard Funds.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=3 face="Arial">Last Reviewed: July 21, 2016</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial">III.14b.4</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT color="#bfbfbf" size=2 face="Arial">July 21, 2016</FONT></P>
